methodology_note: King (1962) density profile using Omega Centauri's published core radius (2.4 pc); central density is a round illustrative value, not a specific paper's number-density fit. This models the general cluster-core population — the 7 real hypervelocity tracer stars (Haberle et al. 2024) are the actual dynamical evidence and are tracked separately, not part of this generated field.
